subject: Sample data sets are missing for some examples

messages.author: c41a3e50d5c239de
messages.subject: Sample data sets are missing for some examples
parts: There are some examples in SparkR. However, there are no sample data sets for examples like kmeans, logistic regression, etc. It is not convenient for uses to have a try. Is it possible to add data generator or sample data sets in the SparkR package?  I tried to reuse the data generators in hibench() for wordcount & kmeans, but the data generated needs conversion, but it's hard for me to deduce the data format required by the SparkR examples from the source code.

messages.author: f4108b5f63668d70
messages.subject: Re: Sample data sets are missing for some examples
parts:
The SparkR examples follow the same input format as the Spark examples. So the data files at 

https://github.com/apache/spark/blob/master/data/mllib/kmeans_data.txt
https://github.com/apache/spark/blob/master/data/mllib/lr_data.txt

should work for KMeans, LR.

We could definitely add similar sample files / document this format in our examples. Feel free to open PRs for such fixes !

Thanks
Shivaram
